title: Firefighter Preparation - Tactical S&C
author: Zachary J.
desc:
This program is intended for experienced individuals due to the high volume, frequency, intensity, as well as the high prevalence of technical movements that require a high level of accuracy. The intention of this program is to improve strength and power production in pressing, squatting and pulling, as well as aerobic capacity and anaerobic work capacity. The first 6 weeks are focused on strength and power development, with accessories focused on developing strength in movement patterns essential to movement patterns present in fire fighting.  There are a few conditioning days to begin building anaerobic and aerobic capacity in phase 1. In phase 2 (second 6 weeks), we work on adding more conditioning days and working on how we utilize the power and strength we just developed in a high work demand environment, with the intention of increasing overall work capacity. De-load weeks (Weeks 7 and 14) should not be skipped. Week 15 is testing and will aid in finding new staring points for speed, agility, power, strength, and endurance.  

It is highly recommended that participants of this program are proficient, and have (or can test to have) established one repetition maximums in the clean and jerk, push press, bench press, back squat, and deadlift. Calculating reserve heart rate can also be helpful, as well as having an understanding of the different ventilatory thresholds.
